summary: Confirmed the existing metric extreme date implementation after the recorded Biome configuration resolution. All acceptance probes and npm run check pass. No additional product changes were needed.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: AC1 AC9 tests at 1280 × 700, 768 × 1024, and 390 × 844. Inspected generated history screenshots against desktop.png, tablet.png, and smartphone.png prototypes. All three metrics show dates below values without clipping or horizontal overflow.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: winter-midnight and summer-midnight tests show 07 Jan · 00:35 and 07 Jul · 01:35 for all metrics.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: two-sensors-and-single-measurement test asserts each metric's Low/High dates and both dates for the single-row sensor using the approved examples.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: unordered-ties test asserts 06 Oct · 08:00 and 06 Oct · 11:00 for each metric's repeated extremes.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: range-change test switches Last day through Last 12 hours to Last 6 hours and asserts Low changes from 05 Oct · 22:00 to 06 Oct · 10:00, with 18.0°C.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: refresh test returns changed latest readings and history, then asserts High changes from 06 Oct · 12:00 to 06 Oct · 14:00, with 26.0°C.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: unit-change test asserts all six dates remain unchanged and Low values become 64.4°F, 46.4°F, and 40%.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: empty-history test selects Last 6 hours and asserts all three empty messages, Low/High placeholders, and zero measurement dates.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: AC1 AC9 tests assert all six extreme dates and header date have computed font-size 13px at each approved viewport.

notes: Followed E1 resolution: retained the owner-committed Biome exclusions and kept the approved spec and prototypes unchanged. The existing implementation from df0c82a required no further edits.
npm run check passed lint, TypeScript checks, coverage, 43 unit tests across all workspaces, and 29 browser tests. The targeted acceptance suite separately passed all 11 tests.

Screenshot comparison confirmed muted dates below values, summaries beside metric titles on desktop/tablet, and summaries below titles on smartphone. Illustrative prototype charts differ from the controlled two-row fixtures, as permitted by the spec.

The utility unit test executed by npm run check also confirms original-value comparisons before rounding and earliest available tie selection before client sampling. No dependencies, APIs, database files, sampling behavior, range boundaries, or other date displays changed.
Removed generated verification screenshots and coverage files before recording this outcome.
